response.justification: Strong overall fit: well over 6 years of full-stack experience (15+), with recent, directly relevant work in TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS and Kubernetes, plus current hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling experience — a rare and explicitly required skill. Deep testing/TDD culture (built test runners and assertion libraries, taught Selenium/TDD courses) aligns well with the quality and code-review expectations. Gaps are mostly framework-specific (no Nest.js or Vitest mentioned, limited recent Kotlin/Java, thin relational/PostgreSQL evidence) and a notable share of career depth is in DLang, which is not transferable to the stated stack. These are easily probed in a technical interview.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js + React full-stack experience with AWS, Docker/K8s and MongoDB
Current AI-agent and MCP tooling work — matches a hard-to-find requirement
Strong testing/TDD credentials: built test frameworks, ran workshops, CI/CD practice
concerns: No explicit Nest.js or Vitest experience; Jest/Playwright not mentioned
Kotlin/Java and relational DB (PostgreSQL) exposure appears dated or shallow
Significant career investment in niche DLang work with limited stack transferability

key_factors.factor: Missing Nest.js, Vitest and current Kotlin/Java
